replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics is a bit of a mixed bag for me. I appreciate the logical structure, especially in computer science and economics, but I find some areas, like advanced physics concepts, quite intimidating. As a 27-year-old Italian from Lecce, math is more of a tool I use pragmatically rather than something I enjoy studying purely for its own sake.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, yes, quite often. My high neuroticism score really shows in how I react to complex numbers or formulas. When deadlines approach or the material gets difficult, I feel my heart race and worry about making mistakes. It makes learning feel stressful rather than exciting, even though I know it's important for my career.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I have used AI tools occasionally, mainly to check my work or get quick explanations. However, because I get anxious easily, relying too much on them can make me feel even more dependent. It helps with simple tasks, but when the concepts are complex, I prefer to struggle through them myself to build confidence, despite the stress it causes.
